status.basis: later of 17 years from grant (2011-12-20) and 20 years from the filing date (1992-09-15), as the patent was in force on 1995-06-08; the French priority date (1991-09-18) does not count toward the U.S. term; maintenance fees for years 4, 8 and 12 were paid (Google Patents legal events 1998-06-03, 2002-05-30, 2006-06-05), so there was no fee lapse; the patent itself was surrendered on reissue as US RE39,484 (reissue application 10/449,786 filed 2003-05-30, reissued 2007-02-06), which runs for the rest of that term; Google Patents lists this number as Ceased for that reason
